newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand's TSFC taps funds to refinance margin loa.
newsitem.headline: Thailand's TSFC taps funds to refinance margin loa.

BANGKOK, May 30 (Reuter) - TSFC Securities Ltd on Friday tapped a 2.5 billion baht ($96 million), three-year loan from state-owned Government Savings Bank to raise funds for refinancing margin loans carried by cash-strapped securities firms. TSFC president Akarat Na Ranong said his firm will pay 11.50 percent for the loan which would be relent to private securities companies as part of a government policy to reduce troubled margin loans in the battered Thai stock market.

He said TSFC, partly owned by the government and the Thai bourse, had earlier refinanced about 2.4 billion baht of margin loans as the authorities tried to curb growing cases of forced sales of shares held by indebted investors.
Akarat estimated that the battered bourse is saddled with 80-90 billion baht of margin loans, of which a large portion has deteriorated to forced sale levels.
Thai stocks have lost more than a third of their market value so far this year and the composite SET index is hovering near its eight-year low of 566.39 on Friday.
